capabilities.name: Code Review
capabilities.description: Peer review of Source Code changes before merge.

items.statement: There should be default / global folder for variables, mixins etc.
There should be modules folder for section wise partial files if sections are used in multiple pages
There should be pages folder for page wise partial files if page styling is unique.
Strictly use Variables for Colors, Breakpoints, Font Family, Font Size, Font Weight. Use Object variables if possible
Create mixins to reuse it in all partial files. Use mixins wherever possible and do not create unnecessary mixins, if not used, remove it.
Use extends / placeholders for repeated styling
& operator should be used for selecting parent and pseudo selectors.
Operators( +,-,*,/,%) : This mathematical operators should be used for calculating % values
Comment your code if necessary, because partial files names are already self explanatory.
Omit unit specification after “0” values. Do not use units (px) after 0 values unless they are required.
Use 3 character hexadecimal notation where possible.
Follow Codecop : Declarations are to be consistently ordered; box-model, display, positioning and etc.
